verdict.rationale: Postman documents a public Postman API for programmatically managing Postman assets and integrating Postman into development toolchains, including CI/CD alongside the Postman CLI. It also documents a programmatic Analytics API. missing for 10: endpoint-level reference detail in the pack (authentication, coverage of all assets, rate limits) and independent or hands-on corroboration of using the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use the Postman API to programmatically manage your Postman assets and integrate Postman into your development toolchain.
combine the Postman API with the Postman CLI to integrate Postman with your CI/CD workflow.
The Analytics API enables you to explore Postman’s analytics reports programmatically.
